purpose: Fail-closed source-batch preflight before handoff to NF06. This contract does not redefine the internal NF06 schema; it proves that an immutable source export is eligible to be handed to NF06, binds that export to the exact reviewed collection frame and frozen instrument content, requires a structured and temporally fresh authoritative rights-hold snapshot at persisted handoff, and emits internal method-coverage plus channel-concentration aggregates required by the separate pre-synthesis readiness gate.
prod_requirements: all records synthetic=false
collection frame is APPROVED_FOR_PROD
collection frame contains only the exact reviewed field allowlist; unknown extra fields fail closed
controller determination reference is present
controller approval reference is present
privacy notice version is present
processor binding reference is present
server/reverse-proxy logging review reference is present
retention schedule reference is present
production research-only storage binding reference is present
instrument versions are fixed
form_contract.json SHA-256 is frozen in the collection frame and matches the repository instrument used for pre-ingest
forms_definition.json SHA-256 is frozen in the collection frame and matches the repository instrument used for pre-ingest
source export SHA-256 matches the bytes actually parsed
collection-channel register SHA-256 is present
every record has an opaque recruitment_channel_id declared in the frozen collection frame
form-specific channel provenance is emitted so the pre-synthesis gate can validate each actually-used channel against its registered audience_scope
per-region and per-form-region channel counts and dominant shares are emitted so concentration cannot be hidden by a low global share
every response_id is a lowercase 64-hex opaque receipt consistent with the HTTP derivation contract
all records validate against the frozen form definitions
all record timestamps fall inside the declared collection window
response_id values are unique within the batch
direct-identifier aliases and identifier-like free text are rejected again at pre-ingest
CRM linkage and commercial tracking remain FORBIDDEN
storage class is RESEARCH_ONLY_SEPARATE_FROM_CRM
persisted PROD handoff requires the exact eucons.ai4work_rights_hold_snapshot.v0.1 structured snapshot rather than an arbitrary response-id iterable
rights-hold snapshot source_class is EUCONS_RESEARCH_RIGHTS_STORE and complete_current_snapshot=true
rights-hold snapshot captured_at is timezone-aware and is not earlier than either collection close or the latest candidate record
rights-hold snapshot contains only opaque response_ids plus bounded control metadata; identity and case narrative are forbidden
test_twin_requirements: the same exact collection-frame allowlist and frozen instrument-content hashes are required for schema parity
response_id uses the same lowercase 64-hex opaque receipt shape as PROD for schema parity
form-specific channel provenance and per-stratum concentration aggregates are emitted for schema and method-control parity
test output is never eligible for PROD promotion

record_provenance.meaning: opaque first-party dissemination-batch identifier, never a respondent/device/CRM identifier

response_receipt.meaning: opaque technical receipt only; never a name, email, contact, CRM, device or recruitment identifier
response_receipt.http_derivation_contract: SHA-256(research_id + form_id + canonical one-submit UUIDv4 idempotency key)

instrument_content_binding.validation_rule: Both hashes must match the exact repository files used by the pre-ingest runtime. If the instrument changes without a matching frozen frame update, pre-ingest fails closed.
instrument_content_binding.historical_reproducibility_rule: A historical batch must be validated from the repository revision whose frozen instrument hashes match the collection frame; silently validating against a later instrument revision is forbidden.

rights_hold_snapshot_contract.response_ids_format: list of unique lowercase 64-hex opaque response receipts
rights_hold_snapshot_contract.temporal_rule: captured_at must include timezone and must be >= collection_closed_at and >= the latest candidate record received_at
rights_hold_snapshot_contract.privacy_rule: Only opaque response receipts and bounded control metadata are permitted. Identity, contact data and privacy-case narrative are forbidden.
rights_hold_snapshot_contract.live_binding_boundary: Repository validation cannot prove that a deployed producer actually reads the authoritative separate research/privacy rights store. That live producer/store binding remains external operational evidence before PROD.

collection_frame_field_policy: Exact allowlist only. Extra fields are rejected so unreviewed semantic changes cannot ride along inside an otherwise valid frame.
canonical_source_export: UTF-8 NDJSON, one canonical JSON record per line, sorted by form_id / received_at / response_id, newline terminated
manifest_privacy_boundary: The pre-ingest manifest contains internal control counts, hashes, timestamps and opaque channel provenance only. The persisted handoff may additionally carry hashes/timestamp/source-class metadata for the rights-hold snapshot, never its receipt list. It must not contain questionnaire answers, free-text responses, raw idempotency keys, IP addresses, user agents, cookies, referrer/UTM payloads, CRM identifiers, optional contact data, identity or rights-case narrative. Method-coverage and concentration aggregates are internal QA inputs and are not public reporting tables.
concentration_rule: The frozen single_channel_share_max threshold is evaluated globally, independently for each region, and independently for each form-region stratum. All count views must reconcile exactly with their denominators and with global channel_counts. If any scope exceeds the threshold, a PASS sensitivity artifact must explicitly cover every exceeded scope before primary synthesis readiness can pass.
pre_synthesis_rule: Passing NF06 source pre-ingest alone does not authorise needs synthesis. A PROD_REAL_EVIDENCE batch must separately pass primary_evidence_readiness.py against the approved METHOD_PLAN_NOT_EVIDENCE collection-frame thresholds and the exact frozen collection-channel-register bytes. The gate must reconcile form-specific channel provenance, validate each actually-used channel against the registered audience_scope, recompute channel concentration from exact counts at global/region/form-region scope, and require scope-complete sensitivity analysis for every threshold exceedance. The persisted handoff must also pass the structured rights-hold snapshot contract. TEST TWIN is rejected by that gate.
promotion_rule: Only PROD_REAL_EVIDENCE batches that pass this contract and the structured persisted-handoff rights control may be offered to NF06. TEST_TWIN output is permanently NON_EVIDENCE.
